metadata.description: Small Claude Code skills that do one job well

plugins.name: session-finder
plugins.description: Show recent Claude Code sessions on a local page with a copy button for each claude --resume command, plus what each was about, where it stopped, and whether it is still open in another terminal.

plugins.name: cricbay-pom-report
plugins.description: Draft a Player of the Match report for a CricBay game from its scorecard, with partnerships, wicket clusters, hat-tricks and the chase equation worked out for you. It never posts anything.
